coastal.title: Wildfire breaks out in Belcarra Park near Port Moody, Anmore
coastal.description: The Coastal Fire Centre says the fire is burning in Belcarra Park and is an estimated 0.8 hectares in size as of Wednesday afternoon.

coastal.title: Metro Vancouver, Fraser Valley under air quality advisory due to wildfire smoke
coastal.description: Some parts of Metro Vancouver have air quality ranked at a Level Nine, with the Eastern Fraser Valley ranked at a Level 10 plus, which means very high risk.

kamloops.title: B.C. resident lost home to Bradley Creek wildfire: ‘It was all just so fast’
kamloops.description: On Saturday, the Bradley Creek wildfire, burning west of Vernon, grew rapidly when wind gusts reached more than 70 kilometres an hour.

kamloops.title: Chief says community was left ‘a war zone’ after Bradley Creek wildfire
kamloops.description: "There are some structures that, I'll be turning 67 in November and those structures were there all my life and to see them suddenly gone, it's just devastating," Dan Wilson said.

kamloops.title: Evac alert expected to be upgraded to order for Quilpituk Creek wildfire
kamloops.description: Central Okanagan Emergency Management said the evacuation orders for the 2,223 properties and evacuation alerts for 425 properties in the wildfire area will remain in place.

cariboo.title: Several evacuation orders in Boston Bar area downgraded to alerts
cariboo.description: The Brunswick Creek wildfire is still considered out of control; however, BC Wildfire advises the risk has sufficiently subsided and residents may return home if they choose to.

all.title: Fire and Climate – a special and timely collection
all.description: The 2026 wildfire season shows us that with increased wildland fire risk, more intense fire behaviour, longer seasons, and fire evolving across many landscapes, a changing climate poses significant challenges to today’s fire regimes and management strategies. The International Journal of Wildland Fire has published a Special Collection to showcase papers from and inspired by […]
